text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Air Navigation (Protected Areas) Order 2015 and comes into operation on 2 June 2015.

heading.en: Area declared to be protected area

text.en:
2. Any area described in the Schedule is declared to be a protected area for the purposes of sections 32 and 33 of the Act.
[S 121/2024 wef 04/03/2024]
